role_summary: Cloud project-management role with FinOps engineering responsibilities across hybrid and multi-cloud transformation, cost optimization and governance.
responsibility_text: Lead cloud transformation and FinOps projects; optimize AWS, Azure, OCI and GCP costs; manage governance, chargeback/showback, budgets and forecasts; analyze infrastructure spend; manage project scope, risks and dependencies; support TCO, ROI and business cases; oversee vendors and executive reporting.
requirement_text: IT project or program management; FinOps or cloud cost management; AWS, Azure, OCI and GCP; hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure; rightsizing, Reserved Instances and Savings Plans; budgeting, forecasting, TCO, ROI, financial modelling; stakeholder and vendor management; enterprise infrastructure and Kubernetes.
preferred_text: FinOps certification; PMP or PRINCE2; banking or regulated-industry experience; governance, risk, compliance and audit knowledge.
